headline: Advent International Raises $30 Billion for Latest Buyout and Mid-Market Funds
summary: Advent International has raised $30 billion for its latest series of buyout and mid-market private equity funds.
why: Advent International is a major global private equity firm, and large fundraising closes indicate robust institutional capital allocation to alternative assets.

impacts.name: Private Equity
impacts.why: Securing capital commitments expands dry powder for future corporate acquisitions and leveraged buyouts.
